title: Specification
description: Blueprint v3.1 §4.1: target/expression, value or bounds, units, tolerance, fixed/free/decision role, provenance. A specification pins a quantity, so it carries the same `kind` vocabulary as Quantity (ADR 0001 D1.3). Whether a set of specifications closes the system is structural analysis (T01), not something this schema decides; the deliberately conflicting SYN-001 heater case is a valid Specification document whose *set* is rejected at validation (plan §3.3, STR-03).

object_type.description: What the path is rooted at: a model instance or a connection (stream).

path.description: Dotted path within the object, for example 'outlet.T', 'state.n' or 'parameters.split_fraction'.

component.description: Component id when the target is one entry of a component-indexed quantity; null otherwise.

scale.description: Registered physical scale the relative part multiplies. A scale is registered, never taken from an iterate (ADR 0001 D3.5).

tolerance.description: Registered tolerance in the form absolute + relative x scale (derivation SYN-001 §9). Case-specific; not applicable to a real process.

role.description: Blueprint §4.1. `derived` is a Quantity role, not a specification role: a derived value is a result, not a specification.
